title: Canadian Pilaf with Nutritious Twist
description: A flavorful and nutritious take on the classic Canadian pilaf, incorporating wholesome ingredients.
instructions: 1. Heat the almond milk in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
2. Add the vegetable broth, pilaf spice mix, salt, and pepper to the saucepan.
3. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
4. Add the diced carrots, green beans, and chopped onion to the saucepan.
5. Cook, covered, for 10-12 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
6. Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes.
7. Add the nutritious rice blend to the saucepan and stir to combine.
8. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the rice is lightly toasted.
9. Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
